contexts: Refund Policy: Customers may return items within 30 days of purchase for a full refund. Items must be in original packaging with all accessories. Proof of purchase required.
Password Reset: If you forget your password, click the 'Forgot Password' link on the sign-in page. Enter your email address and we'll send you a link to create a new password.
Shipping Options: Standard Shipping (5-7 business days) - Free on orders over $50. Express Shipping (2-3 business days) - $9.99. Overnight Shipping (1 business day) - $24.99.
Order Cancellation: You can cancel your order within 1 hour of placing it. After 1 hour, orders are sent to fulfillment and cannot be cancelled.
Payment Methods: We accept all major credit cards (Visa, Mastercard, American Express, Discover), PayPal, Apple Pay, and Google Pay.
Delivery Times: Standard shipping delivers in 5-7 business days. Express shipping delivers in 2-3 business days. Overnight shipping delivers next business day.
Privacy Policy: We collect personal information to process orders and improve services. We do not sell your data to third parties. See full policy at privacy.example.com.
International Shipping: We ship to 50+ countries. Duties and taxes are the responsibility of the recipient. Delivery times vary by country.
Customer Support: Email: support@example.com. Phone: 1-800-XXX-XXXX (Mon-Fri 9am-6pm EST). Live chat available on website.
Warranty: All products include a 1-year limited manufacturer warranty. Covers defects in materials and workmanship. Extended 3-year warranty available for $29.99.
ground_truths: Refunds are allowed within 30 days with receipt and original packaging.
Click 'Forgot Password' on login page and follow email instructions to reset.
Standard (5-7 days), Express (2-3 days), and Overnight shipping available.
Orders can be cancelled within 1 hour of placement only.
Visa, Mastercard, Amex, Discover, PayPal, Apple Pay, and Google Pay accepted.
Standard delivery 5-7 business days, Express 2-3 business days.
Personal data collected for order processing, not sold to third parties.
International shipping to 50+ countries, recipient pays duties/taxes.
Email support@example.com, call 1-800-XXX-XXXX, or use live chat.
1-year manufacturer warranty standard, 3-year extended warranty available.
